contract: Both p1 and p2 must have at least `length` readable bytes; the caller owns that guarantee, this function does no bounds checking of its own. Returns 0 iff the two spans are equal under ASCII case folding; otherwise a nonzero value whose sign matches the first differing folded byte pair's difference. length == 0 always returns 0 without dereferencing either pointer.
rationale: All four cases already hold against the unmodified function (nxt_lowcase folds both operands before comparing, and the while(length-- != 0) loop never dereferences when length starts at 0). This is a coverage-only task: the function is returned byte-identical to how it was read, and the missing test is added.
risk: None expected; if nxt_lowcase's table is ever changed to fold something other than plain ASCII A-Z, this test would need a matching update.
